exploratory.statement: This is an exploratory failure decomposition on already-used validation data; it may only inform the next preregistration and cannot support a final accuracy or promotion conclusion.

interpretation.within_task_heterogeneity: combined lambda=0.5 + anchor is better on 28/38 images and worse on 10/38; negative grid strata: 10x16 (G=160, delta -0.487764). Lowest grid-stratum delta: 10x16 (-0.487764).
interpretation.summary: Frozen diagnosis labels (fixed order): HEADROOM_PRESENT. K48 image-level mean retained-spatial-target-mass delta vs L2+anchor: semantic+anchor +0.237814, combined(lambda=0.5)+anchor +0.246583, oracle+anchor +0.737096. On the preregistered sign the retained-mass deployment link did NOT fail. The prior report's G3 primary test is sign-flipped relative to its stated definition (see prior_report_consistency).

prior_report_consistency.prior_definition: arm B deployed selector minus L2+anchor retained spatial-target mass at K48
prior_report_consistency.note: Prior aggregate_validation computes base - metric = l2_anchor - selector for this key, while its definition states selector - l2_anchor; the reported mean is therefore the negative of the preregistered definition. Reported only; the prior report is not modified.

limitations: Exploratory diagnostic on already-used validation; not a final accuracy conclusion.
No internal test NPZ was resolved, hashed, opened or scored.
Lambda sweep is descriptive only; no significance or promotion claim.
The oracle+anchor mode is an observational reachable upper bound, not a deployable selector.
Image-level statistics treat the 38 images as independent units.
This run reuses the frozen spatial targets, scorer, combine and anchor rules; it does not retrain.

The prior report's G3 primary test is computed as l2_anchor - selector by aggregate_validation, the negative of its stated selector - l2_anchor definition; this decomposition uses the stated sign and reports the discrepancy without editing the prior report.
Retained-mass deltas are descriptive and are not a significance or promotion test; the large oracle headroom only bounds achievable mass, not task accuracy.
